entities.name: Ishi-Ishi
entities.description: An akki vigilante of the Sokenzan Mountains, a crack shot with a sling fond of goats, called King of the Flaming Pebbles; killed by the Mountain Kami.

entities.name: Mountain Kami
entities.description: Kami who killed Ishi-Ishi and burned his body.

entities.name: Akki
entities.description: The goblin-like people who carried off Ishi-Ishi's shell.

events.summary: Ishi-Ishi hurls flaming pebbles with his sling at the kami invaders of his mountain home.
events.quote: constantly used his sling to hurl flaming pebbles

events.summary: Ishi-Ishi flies over the Sokenzan Mountains on a goat and finds the persimmon tree of plenty.
events.quote: found the persimmon tree of plenty

events.summary: Ishi-Ishi is killed by the Mountain Kami and his body incinerated; the akki carry off his shell and leave an inscription.
events.quote: He was eventually killed by the Mountain Kami

relations.note: They killed him and incinerated his body.
relations.quote: He was eventually killed by the Mountain Kami
